appearance.get.description: Read the saved application theme preference.

appearance.set.description: Save appearance changes. Mode controls native windows; colorTheme controls host and plugin content only. Omitted fields are retained.

chatgpt.status.description: Read saved ChatGPT connection summaries without credentials.

chatgpt.signIn.description: Start official ChatGPT OAuth in the system browser; returns promptly. Omit profileId only to register a new account.

chatgpt.cancel.description: Cancel an outstanding ChatGPT sign-in attempt.

chatgpt.select.description: Select a saved ChatGPT registration for the settings picker; models retain their original account binding.

chatgpt.rename.description: Rename a saved account without changing its identity or model bindings.

chatgpt.remove.description: Remove selected local registrations atomically. Requires signed-out accounts with no bound models or active login. Does not revoke remote registrations.

chatgpt.signOut.description: Revoke the renewable session and clear local tokens, retaining the registration.

chatgpt.acknowledge.description: Dismiss the first connected-plan welcome message.

chatgpt.catalog.description: Fetch the current account-specific ChatGPT model catalog using its OAuth token.

chatgpt.addModel.description: Add a model available to the selected ChatGPT account. Does not generate text or switch billing paths.

chatgpt.manageUsage.description: Open ChatGPT Settings Usage in the system browser.

models.list.description: List host-configured models. Credentials are never returned.

models.providers.description: List all Pi provider presets and their configuration requirements.

models.catalog.description: Read the bundled Pi chat model catalog for one provider.

models.save.description: Save a Pi preset or custom OpenAI-compatible model. Omitted keys are retained only when provider and endpoint are unchanged.

models.remove.description: Remove a configured model; active calls prevent removal.

models.generate.description: Start a background text generation. Poll runs.get or subscribe to runs.changed.

runs.list.description: Read the latest 30 run summaries (input/output truncated to 300 characters). Use runs.get for full content.

runs.get.description: Read the authoritative state of a plugin run, also after event reconnection.

runs.cancel.description: Cancel an active run and wait until its terminal state is saved.

plugins.list.description: List installed and built-in applications and their activation state.

plugins.invoke.description: Call a plugin method. Discover method names and input schemas with plugins.list.

plugins.install.description: Install a trusted, prebuilt plugin from an npm spec, Git URL or absolute local .tgz path. Returns an installation job.

plugins.installExample.description: Install the included independently packed Quick Notes example.

plugins.jobs.description: Read recent installation job outcomes and progress.

plugins.setEnabled.description: Enable or disable a plugin. Active runs must finish or be cancelled first.

plugins.uninstall.description: Remove an external plugin and its managed package files. KV and run history are retained.

kv.get.description: Read a plugin-scoped JSON value; absent keys return null.

kv.set.description: Persist a plugin-scoped JSON value (maximum 64 KiB).

appearance.changed.description: Theme preference changed. Reread appearance.get on reconnect.

runs.changed.description: A run changed. Read its current snapshot; notifications have no replay.

plugins.changed.description: Plugin registry or installation jobs changed. Reread their current state.

chatgpt.changed.description: ChatGPT connection or login changed. Reread chatgpt.status.
